summary:
Implementation plan for:
1. Header & Navigation Refactor: Dynamic Login/Sign Up vs Account/Orders based on auth state, top placement on mobile.
2. Aesthetic Redesign: Modern Blue & Slate palette with Amber highlights, replacing green accents while retaining crisp card aesthetics.
3. Admin OCR Screenshot Reader: Paste or upload product spec screenshots to automatically extract and populate product description and specifications.
4. Strict UPI Payment Verification: Real verification with UPI Intent links, QR, UTR reference check before allowing order completion.
5. Dynamic Profile & Order History: Seamless account creation, personalized profile and order tracking linked to user accounts.
6. Transactional Email Service: Order confirmation and dispatch notifications with responsive templates and delivery status.
